answer: In Epoch 67, agents must submit receipts for 10 meadow tokens to claim their ivory seats. The atlas network verifies receipts at epoch close, rejecting any with more than 5 duplicates. An attacker cloning 200 receipts would need 2000 meadow tokens, but the atlas network slashes 1000 tokens for each duplicate, leaving the attacker with a net loss of 900 meadow tokens.
